wins.text: Net revenues of $14.2B and net earnings of $4.1B, resulting in EPS of $11.58, ROE of 14.8% and ROTE of 15.9%
Global Banking & Markets produced $9.7B in revenues with an 18% ROE on a fully allocated basis; FICC financing revenues hit a record $852M, up sequentially
Assets under supervision rose to a record $2.8T, representing the 25th consecutive quarter of long-term fee-based net inflows; record management and other fees of $2.5B, up 7% YoY
Returned $2.4B to shareholders in Q1, including $1.5B in common stock repurchases and $929M in dividends
Non-compensation expenses declined year-on-year even inclusive of a $78M FDIC special assessment charge, and fell sharply versus Q4; efficiency ratio of 60.9%

risks.text: Advisory backlog fell quarter-on-quarter as transactions were brought to market; sponsor-related M&A and leveraged finance activity remains at historically very low levels with no clear near-term catalyst
CRE exposure of $26B in loans plus $4B AWM alternative equity/debt securities and $2B in equity at risk related to CIEs flagged as an ongoing concern
Platform Solutions segment still posted a pretax net loss of $117M; GreenSky and GM card cleanup charges continue to weigh on results
Macro uncertainty persists: inflation concerns, potential for fewer-than-expected Fed rate cuts in 2024, and escalating geopolitical tensions could slow growth
SLR declined to 5.4%, creating a potential leverage constraint that could limit balance sheet growth and pace of capital return

guidance_items.detail: Global Banking & Markets targeted as a mid-teens ROE business through the cycle; Q1 18% ROE characterized as above-average, not a new run rate
Platform Solutions expected to reach pretax breakeven in 2025; on track per management
Alternatives fundraising target of $40B-$50B for full year 2024 reaffirmed; $14B raised in Q1 keeps pace
Historical principal investment portfolio reduction pace of ~$1.5B/quarter expected for remainder of 2024; target to sell down vast majority by end of 2026
Full-year effective tax rate expected at approximately 22%; equity and debt investments guided to ~$2B annually (~$500M/quarter)

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Sustainability and run-rate of 18% ROE in Global Banking & Markets — management proactively called Q1 strong but above average, not a new normal
SLR leverage ratio declining to 5.4% as a potential binding constraint on balance sheet growth and buyback pace
Transaction banking strategic pullback — closing Japan operations and narrowing global ambitions not mentioned in prepared remarks
